data.name: Santana
data.gender_notes: Santana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Santana means 'one who carries the commandments of God' or 'born with a sacred mission'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sant', which means 'peaceful' or 'holy'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu traditions and is believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and success. The name Santana carries the meaning “Born with a sacred mission” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Marathi. Parents who choose Santana usually hope their child will grow to embody born with a sacred mission and live with faith, good character and purpose.
